name: phone-validator
description: International phone number validation, formatting, and extraction supporting E.164 format.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to validate international phone numbers in forms or APIs. Supports E.164 format validation, country-code aware validation, formatting to standardized formats, and extracting phone numbers from freeform text.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The phone number string to validate or format.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'US', 'GB') used as a hint for local numbers.
